title: Palmistry

inlines.v: PAL'MISTRY, noun [Latin palma, palm.] The art or practice of divining or telling fortunes by the lines and marks in the palm of the hand; a trick of imposture, much practiced by gypsies. 1. Addison used it humorously for the action of the hand.
